name: tree_own_screen_v1_amend1
why: the coordinator's update of 08:20 UTC: v66 (v65's chain with the own-points member own_all at weight 1.00 instead of 0.40) is the official best and the incumbent; in-chain readings must be on v66's chain. Recorded before any candidate's in-chain score was read (only the zero-delta identity runs on v65's chain had been scored, as pipeline checks).
status_at_amendment: all 48 fits done and mirrored; four 12-thread controls refitted at 16 threads (docs/tree_own/thread_deviation.json); no candidate table built, no candidate model part, chain or score run

changes.reading.chain: v66's development chain: as declared, with the own-points member own_all at weight 1.00 (configs/ctx_ownpoints_weight_v1.json candidate own_all_w100) in place of 0.40; every other step unchanged (stack_resid_v3 refitted on the rebuilt components, LIRF taking v2)
changes.reading.control: the v66 development proxy runs/ctx_ownpoints_weight/chain/own_all_w100/dev_v66_proxy.parquet column v66 (SHA-256 5bc62cec0af5856de10a9efd195713bd99d73c3e9bacddb38b8bde81c1991c07)
changes.reading.identity: with zero deltas the tool reproduces v66's development model part runs/ctx_ownpoints_weight/chain/own_all_w100/dmp.parquet (SHA-256 5a5c3373...) within 1e-9 s and, unpinned, the v66 proxy within 1e-6 s before any candidate is scored
changes.reading.noise_control: the variance re-allocation's LightGBM picks row- or column-wise histograms by a timing test, so chain reruns can differ by up to about 0.0075% of a month (commit 981d536). Every candidate chain and one more zero-delta identity chain therefore run with that LightGBM pinned (deterministic, force_col_wise; the patch of tools/lirf_own_pinned.py), and a candidate's reading is v66 proxy + (pinned candidate - pinned identity) on every row; the GO bar is applied to that reading against the v66 proxy
changes.reading.v48_runs: the v48 month runs of this amendment use tags runs/daily_totals/tree_own_v66_<candidate>_<kind> (shared by the pinned and unpinned runs of the same model part; the v48 step has no LightGBM)

unchanged: leaves, variants, folds, rounds and the control reproduction requirement
the five candidates and their construction
the GO bar: equal-footing mean <= -0.05%, no month worse than +0.01%, at least two of three equal-footing intervals below zero
